fnol_text: My name is Samuel Okafor and I live at 892 Maple Court, Clinton, NC 28329. You can reach me on (555) 971-7147 or samuel.okafor@example.com. On 30 March 2025 another car pulled out of a side road and hit my front passenger side. The other driver, Ethan Jovanovic, admitted they didn't see me. Policy MT-2023-00103. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Okafor on (555) 971-7147 to acknowledge the claim. Samuel confirmed the loss date as 30 March 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Lucia Okafor gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Ethan Jovanovic reports minor burns to the hand and attended Mercy General. Samuel reports lower back strain.
